# Notation System Usage

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/NotationSystemUsage>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/notation`](../../slices/notation.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

A reified, role- and period-scoped use of a notation system by an entity — an observation in the universal claim stack (observation-spine bridge): the [gufo:Relator](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator) binding {entity} × {notation system} × {role} × {period}, mirroring names' [`NameUsage`](gmeow-NameUsage.md) and languages' [`WritingSystemUsage`](gmeow-WritingSystemUsage.md). Lets a language use IPA for phonetic transcription, a musical work use Western staff notation, or a text use Morse code for encoding, each co-equally and standpoint-scoped.

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator)

Use [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md) as a specialized kind of [`gmeow:Observation`](gmeow-Observation.md), [`gufo:Relator`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-relator). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when a notation system's use by an entity must be first-class — carrying role, period, standpoint, or confidence — so a language using IPA, a work using staff notation, and a text using Morse coexist co-equally without any one being privileged (the reify-on-demand half of the flat [`hasNotationSystem`](../properties/gmeow-hasNotationSystem.md)).

### Avoid when

- Avoid when a plain unscoped link suffices (use the flat [`gmeow:hasNotationSystem`](../properties/gmeow-hasNotationSystem.md)) and avoid stuffing the canonical content itself into the relator; the usage records THAT a notation is used, not the rendered surface form, which is a separate lossy projection.

### How to use

- Mint the relator and fill its four functional roles — [`gmeow:notationUsageTarget`](../properties/gmeow-notationUsageTarget.md), [`gmeow:notationUsageNotationSystem`](../properties/gmeow-notationUsageNotationSystem.md), [`gmeow:notationUsageRole`](../properties/gmeow-notationUsageRole.md), [`gmeow:notationUsageInterval`](../properties/gmeow-notationUsageInterval.md) — then attach standpoint and confidence from the observation spine; pairs with [`gmeow:hasNotationSystem`](../properties/gmeow-hasNotationSystem.md) as the flat shortcut.

### Examples

- ex:u a [`gmeow:NotationSystemUsage`](gmeow-NotationSystemUsage.md); [`gmeow:notationUsageTarget`](../properties/gmeow-notationUsageTarget.md) ex:english; [`gmeow:notationUsageNotationSystem`](../properties/gmeow-notationUsageNotationSystem.md) ex:ipa; [`gmeow:notationUsageRole`](../properties/gmeow-notationUsageRole.md) [`gmeow:notationRoleTranscription`](../individuals/gmeow-notationRoleTranscription.md); [`gmeow:notationUsageInterval`](../properties/gmeow-notationUsageInterval.md) ex:since1888.
